metadata.mechanics: Limit 5 participants per Lineage Target. This Procedure that extends the Gorger Lineage advantage to all participants. When the Procedure is completed call "Upsurge: Gain Basic Gorger Lineage Advantage." Gorgers affected instead regain 2 Body per Minute but may not enter a feeding frenzy.
metadata.descriptionOfRoleplay: There is a secret among Gorgers – a procedure that allows them to bestow their ability to consume large amounts of fresh meat to others. A Gorger first lacerates themselves and others before sharing their blood, allowing their Infection to mingle with others. They push a knife down each person’s throat, followed by a measure of their blood. They make sure to piercing each Strain’s stomach. Once this is done, they encourage each Strain to consume fresh meat – more and more of it. And as the Infection heals their stomach, so too does their stomach enlarge – at least temporarily – to be able to encompass the quantity of flesh.
